title: trained-models-hidden-attractors: code and per-model records for "Do trained models keep attractors hidden? Forced spurious equilibria and a survival law for hiddenness"
description: Code, per-model records and analysis scripts for the article "Do trained models keep attractors hidden? Forced spurious equilibria and a survival law for hiddenness". The archive contains the code that generates the test regimes and training sets, trains echo state networks, next-generation reservoir computers, perceptrons and residual networks, finds their equilibria and labels the reproduced attractors as hidden or excited; one JSON record per trained model (file trained-models-hidden-attractors-records-v1.0.0.zip, 4.4 GB unpacked, with a SHA-256 manifest; unchanged since version 1.0.0); and the scripts that compute every number of the article from these records, with the results as JSON and CSV (file trained-models-hidden-attractors-v1.1.0.zip, a snapshot of the GitHub repository). Version 1.1.0 adds the out-of-sample tests and the mechanism of the survival law (gpu/paper_law_checks.py) and keeps only code and results in the repository.
